entries.en: This is a private sanctuary. Outsiders are not welcome.
This is a private sanctuary. Outsiders are not welcome here.
I don't see any way in. We should just leave them alone.
There appears to be no other way in. Perhaps we should just leave.
I don't see any way in. Let's leave them alone.
I don't see any way in. Let's go.
There's nothing here for us. Let's go.
Father Kyle wants nothing more to do with the Alliance.
Wait...
Father Kyle will speak with you. Head to the building at the far end of the compound. He'll meet you there.
We won't let you take Father Kyle away! He protects us. We need him!
Father Kyle told us that the Alliance wouldn't let us live in peace. This is your last warning. Go away, or we will defend ourselves!
Hack the door open. They won't stand a chance against us!
I bet we can hack the door open.
If you are determined to get inside, we can probably disrupt the security systems to open that door.
The compound is under attack!
I need to talk to the man in charge. It's important.
My name is Commander Shepard. Major Kyle knows me. I have to speak to him.
I want this to end peacefully. If he doesn't see me, people could get hurt.
I understand why Major Kyle built this compound. I'm a biotic; I know what everyone here is going through. I just want to help you.
He shouldn't have killed those investigators. This problem isn't going to go away.
The Alliance wants someone to pay for those murders. Let me speak to Major Kyle and maybe I can find some way to help you all get out of this alive.
He's leading you to your deaths! If you fight the Alliance, you'll all get slaughtered. I'm your last chance. Let me talk to him, or people start dying.
One way or another, I'll find a way in!
I have to see Major Kyle.
You can't keep me out!
I served with him at Torfan.
I'm here to help.
I'm a biotic like you.
Alliance officers are dead.
He needs my help.
He'll get you all killed!
Nobody cares about us biotics. We have to look out for each other.
The Alliance sent assassins to kill Father Kyle, but we stopped them!
Everyone looks at us like we're freaks just because we have biotics.
Don't try anything. We're watching you!
Father Kyle says we biotics have to stick together.
Those other men from the Alliance tried to kill Father Kyle.
Father Kyle says other humans are scared of us because they know we're better than them.
We can't trust the Alliance.
Stop! Let no more of my children die. There has been enough killing!
I am Major Kyle. I know why you have come. We have no quarrel with you. Why can't you just leave us alone?
I know you. The Butcher of Torfan. Why have you come here, Shepard? Why can't you leave us alone?
This... this is not what I wanted. You're just like the ones who came before. Why can't the Alliance just leave us alone?
They wanted to take me away from here! They wanted me to abandon this place. Turn my back on my family. They spoke blasphemy!
I did what I could to make their end quick and painless. I had no other choice. It was necessary to protect my children. Only I can keep them safe.
I respect that you have come under a banner of peace, but I cannot do as you ask. If you take away their father, my children will be helpless!
I speak, but you do not hear. You are like the others -- a blasphemer who must die!
What happened to those other Alliance officers? The ones who came before me?
You killed two Alliance officers. You had to know how this would end.
Somebody has to pay for killing those Alliance officers, Major.
Most of your followers are dead because of you! If you really care about them, surrender now before anyone else gets killed!
You can still get out of this alive, Major. Surrender and nobody else has to die.
I've already killed half the people in this compound. If you don't come with me, all your followers will end up dead. What kind of father lets his children die?
You ordered your followers to kill those Alliance investigators. You must face the consequences of your actions. Do you really want your children to suffer for your sins, too?
You're not leaving me much choice, Major.
I didn't come here to listen to a madman's preaching!
You murdered those men!
That's not an option.
Where are the investigators?
I'm not here to talk.
Safe? They're not safe!
I don't want to kill you.
Enough crazy talk.
You will pay for your crime.
Surrender or they all die!
You can't help them now.
I tried to help you.
I will surrender myself to the Alliance outside the compound gates in one hour, Commander. I give you my word.
I respect that you have come under a banner of peace. But I cannot do as you ask. If you take away their father, my children will be helpless.
No! This... this was my fault. My children are innocent. Pure. Please... I never meant for this to happen. I'm... I'm sorry.
Wait. If my children see you taking me away, they won't understand. They will attack and you will be forced to kill them all.
You have shown me the error of my ways, Commander. Now you must give me time to explain it to them. It is the only way they will understand.
Please, give me one hour. After that, I will meet the Alliance authorities at the gates of my compound and surrender without violence. I give you my word.
I will not betray you, Commander. Thank you for this.
Joker can have the Fifth Fleet pick Major Kyle up. I just hope you know what you're doing, Commander.
Your pilot can have an Alliance Command patrol pick Major Kyle up. I just hope you know what you're doing, Shepard.
Your pilot can ask Alliance Command to send a patrol to collect Major Kyle. I just hope you know what you are doing, Shepard.
Your pilot can get Alliance Command to pick Major Kyle up. But I think this is a bad idea.
I must do everything I can to keep any more of my children from suffering. This is the only solution.
The Alliance sent me to bring you in, Major. Can't you see this has gotten out of hand? Don't you understand you're endangering your followers?
You can still get out of this alive, Major. Surrender and nobody will get hurt.
If you don't come with me, all your followers will end up dead. What kind of father lets his children die?
You're doing the right thing, Major. Your children will be better off for it. Come on.
Come with me, Major. It's over.
I don't want an apology. You have to come with me, Major.
I'm going to trust you. If you betray that trust, you and all your children will suffer.
I think it would be better if you came with me now, Major.
I'm not letting you out of my sight, Major!
We do this my way, Major. Now move out!
I know this isn't easy.
Sorry's not enough.
I believe you.
I'm not sure I trust you.
I don't have much choice.
Biotics can feel safe here.
If you try to take Father Kyle away from us, you'll end up like those other Alliance soldiers.
Just because we're biotics doesn't mean we don't deserve to be treated fairly!
The Alliance wants to wipe us out. Father Kyle told us.
